description: Make a new, empty workspace and put a tab on it.

charts.description: Number of timeframe charts, from the registered 1-8 chart presets.

colour.description: A preset's name or `#RRGGBB`. Left out, the next free colour.

name.description: Omitted or blank chooses the next Workspace N.

tab_id.description: The tab. Left out, the one on screen.

timeframe_ms.description: Initial interval on every chart; omitted uses the current time interval or 5m.
